allowedClaims: At the recorded observation time, the Supabase Management API reported the staging project compute size as nano.
At the recorded observation time, the selected_addons response contained no selected add-on whose published numeric price amount was positive.
The billing observation is not an invoice and does not prove an exact zero-dollar organization balance or amount due.
A valid Ed25519 signature proves that the accepted key holder signed the canonical artifact bytes and that those bytes have not changed since signing.
A successful strict direct libpq connection proves verify-full TLS, SCRAM-SHA-256 authentication, and required channel binding for that observed connection only.
Advisor output is diagnostic and has unproven freshness relative to the Phase 1 V2 DDL.

architecture.controlPlaneReader: one staging-only fine-grained access-token principal with the exact accepted permissions and a literal request allowlist
architecture.databaseAuditor: one pre-provisioned direct-login PostgreSQL role with only a non-inheriting, non-admin, settable pg_read_all_stats membership and no TrailMind or generic mutation privileges
architecture.mutationAuthority: a separately authorized database identity that never receives the auditor credential or signing key
architecture.signer: one-run Ed25519 key delivered through a protected descriptor and pinned by reviewed SPKI SHA-256 before factory reachability
architecture.staticAdmission: digest-pinned pre/post SQL plus a separately reviewed independent read-only catalog/security assertion program and expected manifest

artifactContract.acceptanceContractDigestRule: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact committed UTF-8 contract file bytes
artifactContract.artifactSha256: lowercase hex SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical unsigned artifact bytes
artifactContract.authenticityMeaning: accepted key holder signed the canonical bytes
artifactContract.canonicalization: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme over I-JSON
artifactContract.causalityMeaning: only sequencing, independent nonces, exact transaction and migration receipts, post-commit static assertions, and two fresh cleanup samples may support causal claims

durability.writeMode: create-exclusive temporary file, fsync, atomic rename, fsync parent directory

artifactContract.integrityMeaning: artifact digest and signature detect later byte changes

key.destruction: after the one authorized run, revoke or delete the key in its store, close the descriptor, clear mutable buffers where supported, and report best-effort destruction without claiming physical erasure
key.privateKeyIntake: protected already-open unlinked descriptor containing decrypted PKCS#8 or a protected signing handle
key.rotation: new key requires a new reviewed contract/source revision with a new literal key id, SPKI SHA-256, and validity window

artifactContract.signatureMessage: UTF8('trailmind.production-observer.admission.v2\n') concatenated with RFC 8785 canonical unsigned artifact bytes
artifactContract.truthMeaning: none; signatures do not prove observations are true, fresh, or caused by the migration

cleanup.failurePolicy: if owned objects or unexpected grants exist, set NOLOGIN and PASSWORD NULL, preserve evidence, and require manual review; do not REASSIGN OWNED or conceal the finding
ownerStatements: ALTER ROLE trailmind_phase1_v2_stats_auditor NOLOGIN PASSWORD NULL
REVOKE CONNECT ON DATABASE postgres FROM trailmind_phase1_v2_stats_auditor

cleanupObservation.query: SELECT pid, usename, application_name, client_addr::text AS client_addr, backend_start, state, xact_start, query_start FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = pg_catalog.current_database() AND (pid = ANY($1::integer[]) OR application_name = ANY($2::text[])) AND pid <> pg_catalog.pg_backend_pid() ORDER BY pid
cleanupObservation.requiredAbsence: all mutation PIDs/application names and all prior auditor PIDs/application names

credentialLifecycle.creationAuthority: separate database owner session before the migration
credentialLifecycle.delivery: protected already-open descriptor from an owner-controlled secret manager
credentialLifecycle.expiryProvisioning: a separate owner issues ALTER ROLE trailmind_phase1_v2_stats_auditor VALID UNTIL with a safely quoted UTC timestamp between 1 and 120 minutes after issuance; runtime assertion must report credential_unexpired true

ownerProvisioningStatements: CREATE ROLE trailmind_phase1_v2_stats_auditor LOGIN NOINHERIT NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS CONNECTION LIMIT 1 PASSWORD NULL
GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE postgres TO trailmind_phase1_v2_stats_auditor
REVOKE CREATE, TEMPORARY ON DATABASE postgres FROM trailmind_phase1_v2_stats_auditor
GRANT pg_read_all_stats TO trailmind_phase1_v2_stats_auditor WITH ADMIN FALSE, INHERIT FALSE, SET TRUE

requiredGlobalMutationAssertion.query: WITH target AS (SELECT rolname FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'trailmind_phase1_v2_stats_auditor'), non_system_schemas AS (SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspname <> 'information_schema' AND nspname !~ '^pg_' ), failures AS (SELECT 1 FROM target CROSS JOIN non_system_schemas WHERE pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(target.rolname, non_system_schemas.oid, 'CREATE') UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM target JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class relation ON true JOIN non_system_schemas schema_record ON schema_record.oid = relation.relnamespace WHERE relation.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') AND pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(target.rolname, relation.oid, 'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM target JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class sequence_record ON true JOIN non_system_schemas schema_record ON schema_record.oid = sequence_record.relnamespace WHERE sequence_record.relkind = 'S' AND pg_catalog.has_sequence_privilege(target.rolname, sequence_record.oid, 'UPDATE') UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM target JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc routine ON true JOIN non_system_schemas schema_record ON schema_record.oid = routine.pronamespace WHERE routine.prosecdef AND pg_catalog.has_function_privilege(target.rolname, routine.oid, 'EXECUTE')) SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) > 0 AS has_generic_mutation_access FROM failures

requiredRoleAssertion.query: WITH target AS (SELECT oid, rolname, rolsuper, rolinherit, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb, rolcanlogin, rolreplication, rolconnlimit, rolvaliduntil, rolbypassrls FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'trailmind_phase1_v2_stats_auditor'), direct_memberships AS (SELECT granted.rolname AS role_name, membership.admin_option, membership.inherit_option, membership.set_option FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members membership JOIN target ON target.oid = membership.member JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles granted ON granted.oid = membership.roleid ORDER BY granted.rolname), blocked_memberships AS (SELECT blocked.rolname FROM target CROSS JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles blocked WHERE (blocked.rolname IN ('postgres','supabase_admin','service_role','authenticator','anon','authenticated','dashboard_user','pg_database_owner') OR blocked.rolname LIKE 'trailmind\_%' ESCAPE '\') AND blocked.rolname <> target.rolname AND pg_catalog.pg_has_role(target.rolname, blocked.rolname, 'MEMBER')), owned_objects AS (SELECT 1 FROM target JOIN pg_catalog.pg_database object ON object.datdba = target.oid UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM target JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace object ON object.nspowner = target.oid UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM target JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class object ON object.relowner = target.oid UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM target JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc object ON object.proowner = target.oid UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM target JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type object ON object.typowner = target.oid UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM target JOIN pg_catalog.pg_operator object ON object.oprowner = target.oid UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM target JOIN pg_catalog.pg_collation object ON object.collowner = target.oid UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM target JOIN pg_catalog.pg_conversion object ON object.conowner = target.oid), trailmind_schemas AS (SELECT oid, nspname FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspname LIKE 'trailmind\_%' ESCAPE '\'), trailmind_relations AS (SELECT relation.oid, relation.relkind FROM pg_catalog.pg_class relation JOIN trailmind_schemas schema_record ON schema_record.oid = relation.relnamespace), trailmind_routines AS (SELECT routine.oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc routine JOIN trailmind_schemas schema_record ON schema_record.oid = routine.pronamespace) SELECT target.rolsuper, target.rolinherit, target.rolcreaterole, target.rolcreatedb, target.rolcanlogin, target.rolreplication, target.rolconnlimit, target.rolbypassrls, target.rolvaliduntil IS NOT NULL AND target.rolvaliduntil > pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() AS credential_unexpired, pg_catalog.has_database_privilege(target.rolname, pg_catalog.current_database(), 'CONNECT') AS can_connect, pg_catalog.has_database_privilege(target.rolname, pg_catalog.current_database(), 'CREATE') AS can_create_database_objects, pg_catalog.has_database_privilege(target.rolname, pg_catalog.current_database(), 'TEMPORARY') AS can_use_temporary, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trailmind_schemas WHERE pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(target.rolname, trailmind_schemas.oid, 'USAGE') OR pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(target.rolname, trailmind_schemas.oid, 'CREATE')) AS can_create_or_use_trailmind_schemas, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trailmind_relations WHERE trailmind_relations.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') AND pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(target.rolname, trailmind_relations.oid, 'SELECT')) AS can_read_trailmind_relations, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trailmind_relations WHERE trailmind_relations.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') AND pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(target.rolname, trailmind_relations.oid, 'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER')) AS can_mutate_trailmind_relations, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trailmind_relations WHERE trailmind_relations.relkind = 'S' AND pg_catalog.has_sequence_privilege(target.rolname, trailmind_relations.oid, 'USAGE,SELECT,UPDATE')) AS can_use_trailmind_sequences, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trailmind_routines WHERE pg_catalog.has_function_privilege(target.rolname, trailmind_routines.oid, 'EXECUTE')) AS can_execute_trailmind_routines, (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM owned_objects) AS owned_object_count, (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM blocked_memberships) AS blocked_membership_count, COALESCE((SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('role_name', role_name, 'admin_option', admin_option, 'inherit_option', inherit_option, 'set_option', set_option) ORDER BY role_name) FROM direct_memberships), '[]'::jsonb) AS direct_memberships FROM target
